fieldData.full-article-text:
This document provides step-by-step instructions on how to download, install, and use the Radix Desktop Wallet as part of the Olympia Betanet.

We encourage everyone to try out the Desktop Wallet on betanet with test tokens that do not have value, and will be deleted once the betanet is shutdown, in order to get familiar, create network load for testing, and to identify bugs. If you run into any problems that you think might be a bug, please report them on the #bug-reports channel on the Radix Discord where the tech team will be monitoring for feedback. (Note that we may not be able to answer every report or question.) 

Follow these links to get started:

  • How to Install the Desktop Wallet
  • How to Set Up Your Wallet
  • How to Check Your Token Balances
  • How to Use the Faucet to Get Tokens for Wallet Testing
  • How to Send Tokens
  • How to Reset Betanet Wallet Keystore
